verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only generic 'automated reminders' and 'workflows' feature mentions (docs-4, docs-15) but no documentation of an API, rule engine, or interface for scheduling recurring jobs/workflows in an AI-native or programmatic sense (e.g., cron-like triggers, recurring transaction templates, webhook-driven automation). The MCP server (quickbooks-gh-3/4) exposes CRUD tools but no scheduling/recurrence capability is documented.
